    # The color-4 row separates two binary masks. Overlay their nonzero cells
    # and recolor each occupied result cell to 3.
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row))
    upper = grid[:split]
    lower = grid[split + 1:]
    return [[3 if upper[r][c] == 2 or lower[r][c] == 1 else 0

            for r in range(len(upper))]
